caption:
Slow follow-up kills more deals than bad ads.

Research on lead response time has tracked this pattern for over a decade. Businesses that respond to a new lead within minutes close far more of them than businesses that wait a day.

Most teams aren't in that fast group. Leads sit in an inbox or voicemail longer than the person who submitted them expects, and by the time someone calls back, they've already talked to a competitor.

Pull your last 30 leads this week. Time the gap between the lead coming in and your first reply. That number predicts your revenue better than any ad metric.
